about: The address helpers' shared cases (ergostat/spec/routes.py, web/ui/src/lib/systemRoutes.ts): each model's files, what each path resolves to ([path, expected, why]), the address each thing is written at ([thing, scope, expected]), the names shadowed by the fixed order ([scope, segment, kept [kind, name], lost [kind, name]]) and the things with no address ([kind, name]). Run by tests/test_system_routes.py on both sides.

models.name: factory

files.factory.yaml:
defaults:
  system: factory
dashboards:
  board:
    panels:
      - {panel: chart, refs: stock.shipped}
  overview:
    panels:
      - {panel: chart, refs: stock.arrived}
files.intake.yaml:
defaults:
  system: intake
dashboards:
  ticket:
    panels:
      - {panel: chart, refs: stock.arrived}

resolve: a system's overview: the model's own there
a projection's list in a nested system
an item in a nested system (implied id)
a projection that does not cross: the shorter address is absent
the deeper address redirects to the top-most
ancillary in a sibling: redirected up its own chain
dashboards before projections: the model's dashboard is the projection's list there
pulled up to the top level
a model dashboard in a system
a system's dashboard only in its system
a goal that does not cross
an agent carried into a subsystem redirects to where it is defined
remote is no longer the server's (its API is under /api/remote/): nothing here is named so
a dashboard takes no more segments
a query is not the address

models.name: order

files.factory.yaml:
defaults:
  system: factory
dashboards:
  intake-board:
    panels:
      - {panel: chart, refs: stock.arrived}

resolve: 3 before 4: a subsystem before a projection
read in the subsystem, where 1 is nothing
the shadowed projection, at the top-most scope where its name is free
the redirect skips factory, where the name is taken
a subsystem named as a top-level projection
the projection where it is defined
carried into intake: up to the top level

models.name: short

files.ergostat.yaml:
name: short
systems:
  work: {}
uses:
  questions:
    use: respond-to
    within: work
    with:
      within: 2h
      answer: ./bin/answer.sh

resolve: an instance's goal by its short name inside it
not by its full name there
an instance's block by its short name

files.factory.yaml:
defaults:
  system: factory
dashboards:
  review:
    panels:
      - {panel: chart, refs: stock.waiting}

models.name: keyed

files.ergostat.yaml:
name: keyed
systems:
  cloud: {description: runs instances}
projections:
  instance:
    system: cloud
    query: data.source == 'ec2'
    key: [account, region, instance_id]
    fields:
      account: text
      region: text
      instance_id: text
      state: {values: [running, stopped]}
    events:
      change:
        when: "true"
        account: data.account
        region: data.region
        instance_id: data.id
        state: data.state
  ticket: {query: "glob(key, 'ticket/*')", fields: {state: {values: [new, done]}}}

resolve: a keyed projection's item: its key's parts are the address, its id unchanged
a glob query's item: the glob's prefix left out of the address and put back in the id
